subject: Management Information Systems
notes: MIS core. No numerical questions apply; extra objective and case items included.

questions.text: The system that provides information to managers for decision making is
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: MIS supplies managers with information for planning and control.

questions.text: Data that has been processed into a meaningful form is
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: Information is processed data that is meaningful and useful.

questions.text: The physical components of a computer system are called
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: Hardware is the physical equipment of an information system.

questions.text: An MIS is used only by top management and not by other levels
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: MIS serves all management levels with appropriate information.

questions.text: List the components of an information system
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: Hardware software data procedures and people.
questions.explanation: These five components together form an information system.

questions.text: Explain the characteristics of good information
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: Good information is accurate timely complete relevant and accessible and supports the decisions it is meant for.
questions.explanation: Cover accuracy timeliness completeness and relevance.

questions.text: The system that records day to day business transactions is the
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: TPS records and processes routine transactions.

questions.text: The system that automates order processing billing and inventory is the
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: TPS handles the routine data of daily operations.

questions.text: Enterprise resource planning integrates all business functions into one system
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.topic: E business ERP and emerging technologies
questions.explanation: ERP integrates finance HR production and other functions in one system.

questions.text: List the types of information systems
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: Transaction processing management information decision support and executive information systems.
questions.explanation: These systems serve different managerial levels and needs.

questions.text: Explain the role of information systems in business functions
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: Information systems support marketing finance human resources and operations by automating transactions and providing information for decisions in each function.
questions.explanation: Cover how systems support each functional area.

questions.text: The system that supports semi structured decisions with models and analysis is the
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: A DSS helps managers analyse alternatives for semi structured decisions.

questions.text: The system designed for senior executives with summarised data is the
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: An EIS gives executives a high level view of performance.

questions.text: A decision support system makes decisions for the manager automatically
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: A DSS supports the manager but the final decision remains with the manager.

questions.text: List the components of a decision support system
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: Database model base and user interface.
questions.explanation: These three components enable analysis and what if modelling.

questions.text: Explain the features of an executive information system
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: An EIS provides summarised graphical and easy to use access to key performance indicators and drill down capability for senior executives.
questions.explanation: Cover summarisation graphics and drill down features.

questions.text: The organised collection of related data is a
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: A database is an organised collection of related data.

questions.text: The software that manages a database is called a database management
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: A DBMS stores retrieves and manages data in a database.

questions.text: A data warehouse stores historical data for analysis
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: A data warehouse consolidates historical data for reporting and analysis.

questions.text: Distinguish between data and information
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: Data are raw unprocessed facts while information is data that has been processed into a meaningful useful form.
questions.explanation: Processing transforms data into information.

questions.text: Explain the advantages of database management systems
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: A DBMS reduces data redundancy ensures consistency security and integrity and allows easy sharing and retrieval of data across users.
questions.explanation: Cover redundancy reduction consistency and sharing benefits.

questions.text: The process of creating and building information systems is system
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: System development designs and builds information systems.

questions.text: The series of phases in building a system is the system development life
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: The SDLC is the structured process of system development.

questions.text: Protecting information from unauthorised access is information security
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: Information security protects confidentiality integrity and availability.

questions.text: List the phases of the system development life cycle
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: Feasibility analysis design development testing implementation and maintenance.
questions.explanation: These phases take a system from idea to operation.

questions.text: Explain the importance of information system security
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: Security protects data from loss theft and unauthorised access ensuring confidentiality integrity and availability and maintaining trust and legal compliance.
questions.explanation: Cover the CIA triad and trust and compliance.

questions.text: Conducting business electronically over the internet is
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.topic: E business ERP and emerging technologies
questions.explanation: E business uses the internet for business processes and commerce.

questions.text: The system that integrates all departments of an organisation is
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.topic: E business ERP and emerging technologies
questions.explanation: ERP unifies finance HR production and supply chain data.

questions.text: Artificial intelligence enables systems to mimic human reasoning
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.topic: E business ERP and emerging technologies
questions.explanation: AI gives systems the ability to learn and reason like humans.

questions.text: List the advantages of e commerce
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.topic: E business ERP and emerging technologies
questions.correctAnswer: Wider reach lower cost convenience and round the clock availability.
questions.explanation: E commerce expands market access and reduces operating costs.

questions.text: Explain the benefits and challenges of ERP systems
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.topic: E business ERP and emerging technologies
questions.correctAnswer: ERP integrates data and processes improving efficiency and decision making but is costly complex and disruptive to implement.
questions.explanation: Balance integration benefits against implementation cost and risk.

questions.text: Assertion: A database reduces data redundancy. Reason: Data is stored once and shared across applications
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.topic: Database and data resource management (assertion reason)
options: Both assertion and reason are true and reason explains assertion
Both are true but reason does not explain assertion
Assertion is true but reason is false
Assertion is false but reason is true
questions.explanation: Single storage and shared access eliminate duplicate copies.

questions.text: Match the system to its user
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: Executive systems serve top management while transaction systems serve operations.

questions.text: The detailed description of how a system will be built is the
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: System design specifies how the system meets requirements.

questions.text: The study of whether a proposed system is technically and economically possible is
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: A feasibility study assesses technical economic and operational viability.

questions.text: Explain the impact of information technology on organisations
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: IT flattens structures speeds communication enables new business models and improves decision making while demanding new skills and security.
questions.explanation: Cover structural communication and decision benefits and challenges.

questions.text: Read the case: A retailer has inventory data scattered across three separate systems causing overstocking. Recommend a solution
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.topic: E business ERP and emerging technologies
questions.correctAnswer: The retailer should implement an ERP system to integrate the three systems into one database giving a single accurate view of inventory.
questions.explanation: Apply ERP to consolidate fragmented data.

questions.text: Read the case: A manager must decide whether to open a new store but data is scattered in reports. Suggest a system to help analyse the decision
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: A decision support system would let the manager model sales and costs under different scenarios to compare the options before deciding.
questions.explanation: Apply DSS modelling to support the what if analysis.

questions.text: Explain the types of e commerce
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.topic: E business ERP and emerging technologies
questions.correctAnswer: E commerce includes business to consumer business to business consumer to consumer and consumer to business transactions each linking different parties.
questions.explanation: Describe each type by the parties involved.

questions.text: A primary key uniquely identifies each record in a database table
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: A primary key uniquely identifies each row in a table.

questions.text: Explain the role of MIS in decision making
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: MIS provides accurate timely and relevant information that reduces uncertainty and supports structured semi structured and strategic decisions across management levels.
questions.explanation: Link information provision to better decisions.

questions.text: List the threats to information systems
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: Hacking viruses malware insider misuse and natural disasters.
questions.explanation: These threats compromise data and system availability.

questions.text: Explain the measures for securing information systems
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: Security measures include access control passwords encryption firewalls backups and antivirus software combined with policies and user training.
questions.explanation: Cover technical and administrative safeguards.

questions.text: The data that describes other data is called metadata
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: Metadata is data about data describing its structure and meaning.

questions.text: Explain the evolution of MIS
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: MIS evolved from transaction processing through management reporting and decision support to enterprise and strategic systems integrated by the internet.
questions.explanation: Trace the stages from TPS to modern integrated systems.

questions.text: The process of extracting useful patterns from large data sets is data
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.explanation: Data mining discovers patterns and relationships in large data sets.

questions.text: Explain the importance of data quality in information systems
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: Poor data quality leads to wrong decisions so accuracy completeness timeliness and consistency of data are essential for reliable information and systems.
questions.explanation: Link data quality to decision reliability.

questions.text: Cloud computing delivers computing services over the internet on demand
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.topic: E business ERP and emerging technologies
questions.explanation: Cloud computing provides on demand internet based computing resources.

questions.text: Explain the benefits of cloud computing for business
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.topic: E business ERP and emerging technologies
questions.correctAnswer: Cloud computing reduces capital cost offers scalability and flexibility and enables remote access and collaboration with pay per use pricing.
questions.explanation: Cover cost scalability and accessibility benefits.

questions.text: Explain the limitations of management information systems
questions.subject: Management Information Systems
questions.correctAnswer: MIS limitations include high cost dependence on quality input resistance to change and the inability to handle all unstructured decisions.
questions.explanation: Cover cost data quality and human limitations.
